verdict.rationale: Oneleet's documentation describes service keys built for AI agent automation and MCP servers. These keys are decoupled from user accounts and can be granted either full access or only specific selected scopes, which is least-privilege credential issuance. OAuth-connected assistants are additionally limited to the connecting member's role. Missing for 10: an enumerated catalog of available scopes, documentation of key expiry or rotation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Service keys are decoupled from user accounts and can be scoped for specific tasks.
Grant Full access to all tenant service-key scopes, or choose Limit access to… to grant only specific scopes.
It can only see and do what your own role in the workspace allows, and every action is attributed to your account.
